tasks.label: 🚀 Run Titan-Stable (logged, timeout)
tasks.command:
set -uo pipefail
cd /home/titane-os/Documents/GitHub/TITANE_INFINITY
mkdir -p runtime/stable/logs
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
LOG=runtime/stable/logs/stable-run-$TS.log
APP=$(ls -1 runtime/stable/*.AppImage 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 || true)
if [ -z "${APP:-}" ]; then
  echo "No AppImage in runtime/stable" | tee "$LOG"; exit 1;
fi
chmod +x "$APP" || true
{
  echo "Timestamp: $TS"
  echo "AppImage: $APP"
  echo "Running with timeout 30s..."
  echo "----------------------------------------"
} | tee "$LOG"

# Accepte 124 (timeout) et continue pour écrire le résumé dans le log.
set +e
timeout 30s "$APP" 2>&1 | tee -a "$LOG"
EC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e

echo "----------------------------------------" | tee -a "$LOG"
echo "ExitCode: $EC" | tee -a "$LOG"
if [ "$EC" = "124" ]; then
  echo "✅ OK: app stayed running for 30s (killed by timeout)" | tee -a "$LOG"
else
  echo "⚠️ App exited before timeout (exit=$EC)" | tee -a "$LOG"
fi

echo "Log: $LOG"
exit 0

tasks.label: ⏳ Wait Stable Build Finish (then inventory)
tasks.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /home/titane-os/Documents/GitHub/TITANE_INFINITY
mkdir -p runtime/stable/logs
TS=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
OUT=runtime/stable/logs/stable-build-wait-$TS.log
{
  echo "Timestamp: $TS"
  echo "Waiting for: runtime/stable/build.sh (and Rust build pipeline)"
  echo "----------------------------------------"
} | tee "$OUT"

# IMPORTANT: pgrep -f peut matcher cette tâche elle-même (car la pattern est dans la ligne de commande).
# On filtre donc explicitement le PID courant ($$) pour éviter une boucle infinie.
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  RUNNING=$(pgrep -af 'runtime/stable/build\.sh|tauri build|cargo build --bins|rustc --crate-name titane_infinity' 2>/dev/null | awk -v self=$$ '$1 != self' || true)
  if [ -n "${RUNNING:-}" ]; then
    echo "[$i/120] still building... $(date +%H:%M:%S)" | tee -a "$OUT"
    echo "--- processes (head) ---" | tee -a "$OUT"
    printf '%s\n' "$RUNNING" | head -n 10 | tee -a "$OUT"
    sleep 10
  else
    echo "Build process ended at $(date +%H:%M:%S)" | tee -a "$OUT"
    break
  fi
done

echo "--- runtime/stable ---" | tee -a "$OUT"
ls -la runtime/stable | tee -a "$OUT"

echo "--- bundle/appimage ---" | tee -a "$OUT"
ls -la src-tauri/target/release/bundle/appimage 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$OUT" || true

echo "--- bundle/deb ---" | tee -a "$OUT"
ls -la src-tauri/target/release/bundle/deb 2>/dev/null | tee -a "$OUT" || true

echo "Log: $OUT"
